title: Yummy Venezuelan Chorizo Skillet
description: A savory, dense, quick-fix Venezuelan dish featuring chorizo and a pasta-water emulsion, cooked in a tava-griddle for a whole30-friendly one-pan meal.
instructions: Preheat the tava griddle over medium heat.
Add olive oil, swirl to coat the surface.
Add sliced chorizo and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Remove chorizo and set aside on a plate.
In the same pan add diced onion and cook until translucent.
Add diced bell pepper, minced garlic, and diced tomato, cooking until softened.
Stir in cumin, dried oregano, paprika, and a pinch of cayenne pepper, cooking for 30 seconds.
Return the browned chorizo to the pan and pour in the pasta water, stirring to combine.
Simmer the mixture until the sauce thickens, about 5 minutes.
Season with salt to taste, adjust seasoning if needed.
Serve hot directly from the tava, optionally garnishing with fresh cilantro.
Enjoy your quick, hearty, Venezuelan chorizo skillet.
